name: Arcane
short_desc: Modern Docker container and Compose project management
author: getarcaneapp
description: Arcane provides a web interface for managing Docker containers, Compose projects, images, volumes and networks, with logs, terminals and resource monitoring.

form_fields.label: Application URL
form_fields.hint: Exact browser origin, including scheme and port: http://192.168.1.10:3552 for LAN access or https://arcane.example.com for a domain.
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin without a path or trailing slash.

form_fields.label: Encryption key
form_fields.hint: Keep this generated key and back it up with app-data. Changing it makes existing encrypted credentials unreadable.
